currentTaskDecision: Use isolated EconomyStory with locally bundled fonts, photo-primary semantic assets, stationary frozen fictional actor and narration-aligned wrapper turns. Preserve historical rejected/pending branches. Current r03 frozen render source not changed by this review.

findings: Original30adult roster,15hair/10outfit/accessory combinations. Source-driven SVG2D, not generated footage or learned model weights.
Seven Pose union members:idle,talk,point,shrug,give,receive,celebrate; sheet footer says8poses, a documentation count mismatch.
Rig contains periodic bodyBob/blink and frame-based speaking. Idle alone does not freeze it; frame0+speakingfalse freezes sample.
getCharacter silently falls back to roster0 on unknown ID; production validation should reject invalid IDs before using it.
Export script transpiles TS at runtime and writes both SVGs/roster and workflow finance-cast.json; it is a mutation tool, not a read-only validator.
Two fictional adult leads with comic/toon/line variants; choosing comic direction did not approve this actual artwork.
getHandAnchors transforms elbow/wrist/palm using pose,scale,flip andbodyBob; useful for held-prop geometry when actions are requested.
bodyBob,blink and talk-head motion are procedural; current EconomyStory correctly freezes rig and turns outer wrapper only.
CandidateSheet is1frame of three situations; it cannot prove temporal motion or AV fit.
ComicProof hardcodes globalframe890 and hand-timed daily/dinner sequence; do not reuse as arbitrary new-story renderer.
Receipt width/position derived from both actual palm anchors; useful geometry example, still requires actual contact/motion review.
speaking follows word-presence boolean but mouth uses frame pattern, not phoneme lip-sync.
Scene logic is specific to Minh/Lan salary12→14million,spending10→12million,daily60k×30andmeal200k.
Stage has permanent kicker/title/floor and mostly entrance/reveal content; it should not be treated as general proof against prior slide criticism.
CastFilm speaking assumes frame/30 and historical words; visual schema fallbacks render hook rather than reject unsupported values.
Minimal implements fixed Header/Reveal/ledger/Note layouts with many long holds after entrance; rejection is recorded in instructions, not newly inferred aesthetic judgment.
Fixed numerical copy and calendar/transfer labels are tied to old salary script.
Fallback uses full segment.text as headline; could become dense or overflow for unknown content.
SystemArial only, size by fixedlayout; current typography improvement must remain isolated to new source for historical reproducibility.
Objects exports reusable SVGbill/wallet/envelope/receipt/printer/plate/hand primitives with documented origins.
timing.cue searches normalized exacttake words but hardcodes30fps; unmatched phrases silently use fallbacks, so source presence is not proof that timing was exact.
FlowFilm daily→dinner preserves one printer/receiptpile and conditional obligations; meaningful content mechanisms can be extracted when relevant.
Budget conserves illustrated one-million tokens for fixed12/10/2and14/12/2 examples; arbitrary counts/amounts are not a generic financial visualization.
Paper allocations use symbolic lengths explicitly described as illustrative; no recommended savings percentage should be inferred.
Main scene map+actionScenes include many actual topic-specific actions; nevertheless user rejected the long film as slides. Code comments claiming finite causal motion do not override that feedback.
Permanent title/chapter/header/progress/footer and scene entrance/drift are visible source policies; unsuitable as untouched new content-first baseline.
resultFrame target phrase is selected by oldkind and text-specific Vietnamese phrases; unmatched target falls back to provided value.
Action variants include conditional assumptions,ownprogress,duplicate-transfer,reimbursement,fullpurchasecost and essential-protection; semantics are reusable concepts, not universal scene assets.
Bubble/Note/Phone shrink text using text.length×heuristic width, not actual bundled font pixel measurement; no minimum readable size/crop proof in helper.
Several scene strings,token counts and geometry are fixed to old script; do not call all declareddata fields generic.
438line renderer has16kind scenes and extensive per-action/per-ID overrides; action-count is code coverage, not visual acceptance.
Permanent header/footer/progress and generic entry wipe remain; user rejection remains authoritative.
aligned() reads fps from plan for exact word matching; general phase/cue animations still rely on duration fractions/fallbacks and must not be labeled exactphrase absent a match.
FlowMechanisms fixture sets from:-270 andduration360 to inspect a single lateframe; it is a still fixture, not complete motion review.
Unknown/outside timeline fallback differs between legacy renderers; validate continuous coverage in compiler instead of relying on fallback rendering.
Shot-driven split plus continuation/final-state/timing modules replaces some earlier repetition but uses hardcoded bXX IDs and part-specific branches throughout.
part%3 in money-scenes/decisions can cycle setup variants for later parts unless explicitly overridden; many fixes are beat-specific, not a general continuity guarantee.
Numeric recurring/annual branches test for data presence but display fixed120000/month,1440000/year,1200000annual and100000monthly; do not reuse with arbitrary amounts.
person() caps scale at1.6 despite many callsites requesting1.65–1.8; apparent requested scene scale is not actual rig scale.
art.Person supports prop union phone but only draws cash/receipt; phone prop yields character without phone.
Current selection should favor photo+narration; simulated cup/bike/jar/receipt motion does not supply real photographed context.
Scene map prioritizes subscribe,outro and continuations; Continuation dispatch order can override base scene/action behavior.
phraseAt reads exacttake words with planfps but fallback remains genericcueFrame; cueProgress may complete numbers at matched wordstart.
Most scene branches use hardcoded bXXIDs,fixed example values and shotpart saturation/modulo; incompatible with arbitrary economy script without a new planner.
Primitives are imported from finance-flow/Objects, so deleting a rejected family could break optional simulations and historical reproduction.
Progressions add consequences/checks rather than replaying entrance, but source comments do not establish aesthetic acceptance or repair the lack of photos.
PhotoStage supports full/split/gallery, sourcefocus and contain backed byblur; only first3photos are used in gallery and full usesfirstasset.
TimelineFilm explicitly delegates simulation shots to finance-pace modules; their prior subject-specific assumptions remain.
Photo captions/context/subscribe overlays and disclaimer reference Minh/Lan and oldretainedtake; these strings must not silently carry to new Hạnh story.
Old Python runner finance_photo_render.py pins prioraudio/timeline and references absent finance_photo_plan.py.
CaptionTrack trusts upstream cue length and maxwidth; no independent2line or actual glyph measurement validation in this component.
